research_question: What is the locked WSST-driven REM-Net continuous-ECG performance under the complete repaired 11-fold strict-LOSO protocol?
model: REM-Net continuous B1 with WSST-only input and locked L3 MR-STFT waveform loss

protocol.validation: one distinct subject per fold; checkpoint selection only
protocol.test: one held-out subject per fold; opened exactly once after checkpoint selection
protocol.split_invariants: train/validation/test subject-disjoint per fold; each subject test exactly once; each subject validation exactly once; all validation files distinct
protocol.target: blind continuous 1x1600 ECG in train-fold robust-scaled space; reported in raw ECG units
protocol.test_oracles_prohibited: No test-derived scaler, lag, affine map, range-bin selection, threshold, checkpoint, or model choice

training.budget: 100 epochs maximum, patience 15, AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 16
training.loss: Huber + 0.20 event BCE + 0.50 MR-STFT; FFT/window 128/256/512, hops 32/64/128
training.checkpoint: maximum frozen validation composite only; Shape-200 excluded; epoch-level atomic recovery enabled

metrics.aggregation: fold-macro mean and population standard deviation over 11 test subjects; per-fold values retained
metrics.nan_policy: nanmean within evaluator; record NaN/failed values before promotion

promotion_limit: One seed of the registered three-seed audit; conclusions use all three seeds.

multi_seed_audit.changes: seed base only; model, loss, budget, split, scaler, evaluator and checkpoint rule are identical
